core: HPA-axis stress hormone secretion and response
qualifier: social, reproductive and emotional behaviors
name: HPA-axis stress response and social behaviors
rationale: Members combine CRH/ACTH/glucocorticoid secretion and stress responses with mating, parental, aggressive, fear and drinking behaviors, which separates it from the sleep/feeding neuropeptide confusables and the glucocorticoid-signaling confusable lacking behavior.

qualifier: Leloir galactose route, glucuronate-xylulose pathway and inherited defects
name: Galactose (Leloir) and pentose/glucuronate sugar metabolism
rationale: All members are galactose (Leloir enzymes and their deficiencies) or pentose/glucuronate-xylulose metabolism steps and defects, distinguishing it from fructose/alditol confusables and the non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt confusable.

qualifier: interactions, trafficking, degradation and signaling rather than transcription or junction assembly
name: E-cadherin and cadherin-11 protein interactions and turnover
rationale: Members concern CDH1/CDH11 at the protein level (trafficking, degradation, homotypic binding, CDH11-STAT3 signaling, E-cadherin-mediated Listeria entry), whereas confusables cover cadherin gene transcription or adherens junction assembly.

qualifier: pain and thermal sensory perception
name: Two-pore-domain potassium channels in pain and thermosensation
rationale: Members are TREK/TASK/THIK/TRESK/TWIK K2P channels, resting potential and pain/temperature detection, distinguishing it from confusables built on TALK/TRP sour taste, itch/fever or Ca2+-activated K+ channels.

core: Adipocyte differentiation and adipose tissue development
qualifier: PPARgamma-driven white, brown and beige adipogenesis
name: PPARgamma-driven adipocyte differentiation and adipose tissue development
rationale: Members are white/brown/beige fat cell differentiation, adipose development and PPAR signaling regulation, unlike confusables centred on LXR lipogenesis, triglyceride homeostasis, thermogenesis or PGC-1alpha/circadian control.

qualifier: with GTPase activity regulation
name: Regulation of nuclear protein import/export and GTPase activity
rationale: Most members regulate protein import into and export from the nucleus or GTPase activity (plus two mixed growth-control modules), distinguishing it from confusables about nuclear pore structure, RNA/ribosome export, viral protein maturation or PML bodies.

qualifier: respiratory complex assembly with heme and iron-sulfur cofactor biosynthesis
name: Oxidative phosphorylation and heme/iron-sulfur cofactor biosynthesis
rationale: Members span electron transport, ATP synthase and respiratory complex assembly together with heme, Fe-S cluster and ubiquinol biosynthesis, setting it apart from TCA cycle, mitochondrial protein import/cristae and mitochondrial translation confusables.

qualifier: CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition
name: Proximal TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members are CD3/ZAP-70 proximal TCR events and CD28 costimulatory and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibitory signaling, unlike confusables covering downstream TCR/NF-kB, BCR signaling or T cell differentiation.

qualifier: betaglycan (TGFBR3), activin/follistatin and TGFBR1 cancer mutants
name: Betaglycan- and activin-centred TGF-beta superfamily receptor signaling
rationale: Members concern receptor-level events (TGFBR3 regulation, activin/follistatin, AMH receptor, TGFBR1 and SMAD2/3 phosphorylation-motif mutants), whereas confusables cover SMAD transcriptional output, TGFBR2/SMAD4 mutants or gonadotropin secretion.

qualifier: mechanoresponsive proliferation and focal adhesion
name: Mechanoresponsive stromal fibroblast activation and proliferation
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal YAP-TAZ mechanoresponsive modules, collagen/TGF-beta, focal adhesion assembly and fibroblast proliferation, distinguishing it from confusables focused on ECM composition, EMT, fibronectin/integrin or migration.

qualifier: downstream TRAF3/TRAF6-mediated IRF and NF-kappaB activation
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling via TRAF-mediated IRF and NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members are RLR signaling and its TRAF3/TRAF6/FADD-RIP1 downstream activation of IRFs and NF-kB, while confusables emphasise positive/negative regulation of RIG-I/MDA5, dsRNA response or interferon production.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism with inborn errors
name: Purine de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: All members concern purine (IMP/AMP/GMP, PRPP, adenosine/guanine) synthesis, salvage or breakdown and their enzyme defects, unlike confusables on pyrimidine metabolism or nucleoside triphosphate/thiopurine catabolism.

qualifier: presynaptic organization via receptor tyrosine phosphatases and SALMs
name: Synaptic adhesion and presynapse assembly via RPTPs and SALMs
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion and synapse/presynapse assembly regulation including RPTPs and SALMs, whereas confusables centre on neurexin-neuroligin and postsynaptic receptor/PSD-95 clustering.

qualifier: Fas/TRAIL-caspase-8 signaling in T cell immunity
name: Fas and TRAIL death-receptor apoptosis in T-cell immunity
rationale: Members are FasL/TRAIL-caspase-8-c-FLIP-BID extrinsic apoptosis together with T cell activation-induced death, thymocyte apoptosis and allograft/tumor rejection, distinguishing it from mitochondrial apoptosis, necroptosis and negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: degranulation and formyl peptide receptor response
name: Neutrophil degranulation and formyl peptide receptor activation
rationale: Members are neutrophil degranulation, formyl peptide receptor responses, neutrophil recruitment and complement receptor signaling, unlike confusables about granulocyte chemotaxis control or monocyte inflammatory responses.

core: Base excision repair downstream of glycosylases
qualifier: AP-site processing, gap filling and OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defects
name: Base excision repair gap filling and OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defects
rationale: Members cover APEX1 AP-site processing, short- and long-patch gap filling and defective OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1, whereas confusables cover damaged-base recognition and cleavage, NEIL1/NEIL3 defects and strand-break repair.

qualifier: COPII export and COPI retrograde coat-mediated transport
name: COPII and COPI coated vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi
rationale: Members are COPII cargo loading/coating and ER export plus COPI budding and retrograde traffic, unlike confusables on vesicle targeting/tethering, ER quality control/ERAD or SRP-dependent ER targeting.

qualifier: TNF receptor superfamily-driven canonical and non-canonical (NIK) pathways
name: TNF receptor superfamily canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members are TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF-driven canonical and NIK-dependent non-canonical NF-kB activation with linear ubiquitination, distinguishing it from TLR/RIP1, NF-kB negative regulation and lymphocyte NF-kB confusables.

qualifier: activation and regulation across classical, lectin, alternative and terminal pathways
name: Complement cascade activation and regulation
rationale: Every member is complement activation (classical, lectin, alternative, terminal) or its regulation, sharing nothing with confusables on Fc receptors, myeloid cells or antimicrobial defense.

qualifier: filtration barrier: podocytes, mesangium and basement membrane
name: Glomerular filtration barrier and mesangium development
rationale: Members are glomerular vasculature, podocyte, mesangial and basement membrane development plus filtration and nephrin/laminin interactions, unlike confusables on nephron tubule development or brush border/epithelial polarity.

qualifier: GTPase cycles and effector activation (ROCK, PAK, WASP/WAVE, formins)
name: Rho family GTPase cycles and effector activation
rationale: Members are individual RHO/RAC/CDC42/RND GTPase cycles, their effectors and upstream G12/13 and Sema4D inputs, while confusables focus on downstream actin filament mechanics or negative adhesion regulation.

qualifier: dendritic cell cytokines and CCL5, with STING/inflammasome/GBP regulation
name: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production with STING/inflammasome regulation
rationale: Members regulate dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5/chemokine production alongside cGAS-STING, inflammasome and GBP-mediated defense, distinguishing it from macrophage chemokine, interferon and Th1/IL-12 confusables.

qualifier: leukocyte heterotypic cell-cell adhesion
name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte heterotypic cell-cell adhesion
rationale: Members are integrin activation and integrin/PECAM1-mediated heterotypic cell-cell adhesion of leukocytes, unlike confusables on integrin-to-MAPK/Rap1 signaling or immunological synapse formation.

qualifier: proliferation, differentiation and survival regulation
name: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and survival regulation
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte and epithelial proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis (including in wound healing), unlike confusables on cornification/skin barrier, melanocytes or wound inflammation and migration.

qualifier: defensins
name: Defensin and antimicrobial peptide production
rationale: Members are alpha/beta defensins and the production and regulation of antimicrobial peptides, distinguishing it from confusables on antifungal/neutrophil cytotoxicity, metal sequestration or intestinal epithelium.
